Incoterms 2020

Manifest Amendment

An official alteration or correction to the details in a cargo manifest, made to reflect changes in cargo, consignee, or other shipment data before customs clearance.

Quick answer: An official alteration or correction to the details in a cargo manifest, made to reflect changes in cargo, consignee, or other shipment data before customs clearance.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Manifest Amendment?

In this glossary, Manifest Amendment refers to: An official alteration or correction to the details in a cargo manifest, made to reflect changes in cargo, consignee, or other shipment data before customs clearance.

How is Manifest Amendment used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "A manifest amendment was filed to update the consignee information before cargo discharge and customs processing."

Why does Manifest Amendment matter in logistics?

Manifest Amendment matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Manifest Amendment?

Manifest Amendment is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Manifest Amendment belong to?

In this glossary, Manifest Amendment is grouped under Incoterms 2020. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An official alteration or correction to the details in a cargo manifest, made to reflect changes in cargo, consignee, or other shipment data before customs clearance.

Operational example

A manifest amendment was filed to update the consignee information before cargo discharge and customs processing.
